title: ClueCon 2019
html:
It is less than one month to ClueCon 2019, held in Chicago, USA, during August 5-8 — the conference organized by the FreeSwitch developers and SignalWire. This is another edition where Kamailio project will be very well represented.

There will be three presentations from Kamailio developers, respectively:

  • by Daniel-Constantin Mierla – Versatile SIP Routing With Kamailio Embedded Scripting Languages – on August 7, at 9:45am
  • by Fred Posner – Three Ways Kamailio can Help Your FreeSWITCH Deployment – on August 8, at 9:45am
  • by Julien Chavanton  – Flowroute WebRTC to VoIP Platform

The schedule of the even is available at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com/events/?tribe-bar-date=2019-08-05

If you want to read more about the content of the event and Kamailio, an extensive article has been published on Kamailio World website:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k07/2019/06/cluecon-2019-15-years-challenge/

Check for the discounts offered for registration, it is one of the events you have to attend in real time communications field — if you haven’t done it yet it the right time to do it now — watch the twitter account of ClueCon for such announcements or see the web page:

  • https://www.cluecon.com/low-price-2/

More details about the event on their web page:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

Looking forward to meeting many of you in Chicago during ClueCon!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
